name: Aquaguard MIST UV
summary: Aquaguard MIST UV is a sleek, wall-mounted UV water purifier designed for municipal water with TDS up to 200 mg/L.
intro: The Aquaguard MIST UV is a premium wall-mounted UV water purifier designed for municipal water with TDS up to 200 mg/L. Featuring UV E-Boiling Technology, Mineral Guard Technology, and a smart, storage-free design, it delivers safe, mineral-rich drinking water with a high flow rate. Its sleek European styling, touch controls, energy-saving mode, and long-lasting cartridge make it an ideal choice for modern homes.
features: UV E-Boiling Technology for superior purification
Mineral Guard Technology retains essential minerals
Smart purifier with service and performance alerts
Touch Sense controls for easy operation
High water dispensing rate of 60 LPH
Energy Saving Mode for reduced power consumption
Suitable for municipal water with TDS up to 200 mg/L
